status: fixed before v2 outcomes; development experiment, not untouched test
datasets: TCOW Rubric Cup Games local (Perception Test derived)
input: earliest query mask pooled into identity feature; subsequent RGB frames in order
temporal_access: causal; every decoded frame from query through last endpoint
candidates: top 12 local peaks of frozen-query dense feature cosine; 2-token suppression radius
spatial: stationary, velocity, local-flow alternatives; mixture weights updated from accepted residual likelihoods
acceptance: selected appearance >=0.65 and selected association gap >=0.15; fixed uncalibrated gates
adaptation: EMA rate0.05 only if initial-anchor cosine >=0.8 and association gap >=0.5; retain initial anchor
metrics: sparse endpoint mask membership, accepted coverage and misses; full traces released; no dense episode claims
limitations: no semantic container inference, no calibrated coverage, no heldout scenes, no physical control
primary_comparison: same encoder/candidates; determine whether memory actually changes selection and improves endpoints
